name: claude-mods
description: Progress, usage, context, safety, git and notes mods for Claude Code.

plugins.name: task-progress
plugins.description: Always-visible progress band above the prompt: follows the todo list, lets Claude report progress with a tool, shows a working timer and your 5h / weekly usage.

plugins.name: usage-dashboard
plugins.description: /usage-dashboard pane: 5h and weekly limit %, current and top model, tasks, time left and limit risk.

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: Context-window meter with warnings at 70% and 90% so you compact or start fresh in time.

plugins.name: safety-guard
plugins.description: Blocks destructive commands, force pushes, pipe-to-shell installs and writes to secret or key files.

plugins.name: git-band
plugins.description: One-line git status band above the prompt: branch, ahead/behind, staged, changed, untracked.

plugins.name: notes-todos
plugins.description: Your own persistent todo list and notes across sessions with /mytodo and /mynote.
